description: MCP server connecting your Zotero library to Claude and other AI assistants (search, cite, summarize, semantic search). Installs the PyPI package 'zotero-mcp-server' (54yyyu); the command is 'zotero-mcp'.
notes: zotero-mcp is an MCP server: your AI tool launches it on demand over stdio, so you do NOT run it standalone or set it to auto-start.
Register it in your AI tool's MCP config:
Claude Code:    claude mcp add zotero -- zotero-mcp
Claude Desktop: run 'zotero-mcp setup' (writes the Desktop config and guides the Zotero 7 local API)
Semantic search is optional and NOT installed here; it needs the 'semantic' extra (pulls in chromadb, ~0.5-0.8GB).
